business_rules.requirement: There is no fixed rest day. Every day of the week is open for service, and the admin decides what is scheduled.

business_rules.requirement: The plan includes exterior cleaning 7 days a week. On the customer's chosen day the visit also includes interior cleaning. If that day is skipped, paused or skipped by operations, that week's interior cleaning is lost and not made up. Deep Spa is not part of the plan: a subscriber buys it separately as an add-on, and a customer without a subscription can take it as a standalone service (section 9a).
business_rules.note: P12 coded after owner decision: admin creates a customer/vehicle without a plan or plan payment. Owned standalone Spa uses the subscriber catalogue/date/finish-by/cutoff/UPI/admin-confirmation/cancellation rules, payment-independent 120-minute scheduling, outcomes and visit proof/history. Portal and mobile expose it. Legacy unlinked requests stay honest; no synthetic subscription or historical rewrite. API/portal/mobile regressions written/unrun. Admin visit/job skips, reason/note/history and idempotent exterior-only plan/payment extensions exist.

business_rules.requirement: Every customer change to a date's schedule (skip, un-skip, start or end of a pause, a new service cutoff time, an add-on change or cancellation) must be made by 9 PM the previous day. After that the customer calls the helpline for emergency changes. Skipped visits are not charged and the crew is notified automatically.
business_rules.note: Skip/un-skip rules, calendar refresh, notifications hooks and cutoff checks are present. Backend events/inbox/preference or crew fan-out hooks exist, but sender is LoggingPushSender and default mobile NoPushTokenProvider returns null. Firebase/OS permission/token refresh/logout/foreground-background handling and device delivery remain missing. Related tests mock delivery.

business_rules.requirement: A pause covers a date range, with no minimum or maximum length in MVP. Paused visits are added to the end of the plan, so the renewal date moves forward by the number of visits paused. Ending a pause early recalculates it. A skip is a subset of a pause: skipped dates inside a pause are counted once, as paused days.
business_rules.note: Pause range/preview, merge and early-end behavior uses the shared cycle rules. P03 coded: pause/cancellation/early-end transactionally shifts affected unpaid plan due/cycle/overdue dates and pending plan boundaries; Received/voided/add-on records are protected. Manual future plan records without a cycle key are supported. Status/idempotency/early-end regressions written/unrun.
